name: PA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Brendan Boyle with large cash advantage
Markets price Democratic win near certain
model.rationale: Boyle holds a D+19 seat with over $5.5 million on hand against a Republican challenger with no reported fundraising, and prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%. No polls or expert ratings contradict the fundamentals, so the forecast stays at a wide Democratic margin.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or Boyle's retirement before the general election would be the main way this race tightens.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brendan Boyle is a well-established incumbent in a Philadelphia-area district that leans heavily Democratic, with a partisan lean of about 19 points. He has raised roughly $2.5 million this cycle and holds over $5.5 million in cash, with no outside groups spending against him.

His Republican opponent, Jessica Arriaga, has no reported fundraising and little public profile. Prediction markets put the Democratic win probability near 97%, and no polls or expert ratings suggest the race is competitive. The expected margin is about 25 points, with the main uncertainty coming from low-information races rather than any evidence of a contest.
